tagline: Your local shop for outdoor power and gear
heroSubheading: Where Albany gets the equipment and advice it needs.
aboutHtml:
We're Steve and Emma Marshall, and we run this shop for Albany. Locals come here for outdoor power equipment, everything from chainsaws and lawnmowers to all the gear that keeps properties running. We help you find the right tool for the job. Shop in store or order online.

We specialise in high-quality STIHL tools and accessories, plus Masport, Honda, Rover, Cub Cadet, Fiskars, Red Band, Silky, Wolf Garten, Billy Goat, Hustler, and Weber BBQs. You'll find parts, service, advice, and repairs all in house. We're here to help you get the right kit and keep it running.

We're active in our Albany community. We work with local schools, support sports clubs, and help out where we can. Come in and see us. Open Monday to Sunday.
